title: Feature request: bring back /buddy as a permanent feature
body:
The `/buddy` slash command (April 1st easter egg) was a fun addition — it hatches a small creature that watches you code. Would love to see it come back as a permanent or opt-in feature rather than being limited to April Fools' Day.

Many users enjoyed it and it adds a bit of personality to the coding experience without getting in the way.
author: tomasgilcomplif
